items.example: For such a famous actor, he's very down-to-earth.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar ünlü bir oyuncu için çok mütevazı.
items.simple: A normal, simple person who does not act like a big star.

items.example: I don't trust her. She's so two-faced.
items.exampleTr: Ona güvenmiyorum. Çok iki yüzlü.
items.simple: Nice to your face, but says bad things when you are not there.

items.example: My sister is really outgoing and makes friends everywhere.
items.exampleTr: Kız kardeşim çok girişken ve her yerde arkadaş edinir.
items.simple: Friendly and happy to talk to new people.

items.example: He's as stubborn as a mule. You'll never change his mind.
items.exampleTr: Katır gibi inatçı. Fikrini asla değiştiremezsin.
items.simple: Someone who never changes what they want, even when they are wrong.

items.example: I'm not a people person. I prefer working alone.
items.exampleTr: İnsan ilişkilerinde iyi biri değilim. Tek başıma çalışmayı tercih ederim.
items.simple: Someone who loves being with others and is good at it.

items.example: Don't be so gullible. It's obviously a scam.
items.exampleTr: Bu kadar saf olma. Belli ki dolandırıcılık.
items.simple: You believe everything people tell you, even silly things.

items.example: He seemed a bit aloof when we first met.
items.exampleTr: İlk tanıştığımızda biraz mesafeliydi.
items.simple: Someone who stays away and does not talk to others much.

items.example: It's narrow-minded to judge people by their clothes.
items.exampleTr: İnsanları kıyafetlerine göre yargılamak dar görüşlülüktür.
items.simple: You will not listen to new ideas because you think you are right.

items.example: The salesman was so pushy that I left.
items.exampleTr: Satıcı o kadar ısrarcıydı ki oradan ayrıldım.
items.simple: Someone who keeps asking and does not take no for an answer.

items.example: He's so vain that he checks every mirror he passes.
items.exampleTr: O kadar kendini beğenmiş ki geçtiği her aynaya bakıyor.
items.simple: Someone who thinks they look very good and loves to look at themself.

items.example: She's quite reserved, but she's lovely once you know her.
items.exampleTr: Oldukça içine kapanık ama tanıyınca çok hoş.
items.simple: Someone who is quiet and does not say much about themself.

items.example: She's very mature for her age.
items.exampleTr: Yaşına göre çok olgun.
items.simple: Someone who thinks and acts like a grown-up.

items.example: It was very considerate of you to call.
items.exampleTr: Aramış olman çok düşünceli bir davranıştı.
items.simple: You think about how other people feel and are kind to them.

items.example: He may look scary, but he has a heart of gold.
items.exampleTr: Korkutucu görünebilir ama altın gibi kalbi var.
items.simple: Someone who is very, very kind inside.

items.example: My little brother is a real pain in the neck.
items.exampleTr: Küçük kardeşim tam bir baş belası.
items.simple: A person who bothers you all the time.

items.en: the life and soul of the party
items.example: Dave is always the life and soul of the party.
items.exampleTr: Dave her zaman partinin neşesidir.
items.simple: The person who makes everyone laugh and have fun.

items.example: Don't worry about the dog. He wouldn't hurt a fly.
items.exampleTr: Köpek için endişelenme. Kimseye zarar vermez.
items.simple: Someone so gentle that they never hurt anything.

items.example: Ever since he got promoted, he's been full of himself.
items.exampleTr: Terfi aldığından beri kendini çok beğeniyor.
items.simple: You think you are better than everyone else.

items.example: She looks down on people who didn't go to university.
items.exampleTr: Üniversiteye gitmemiş insanları küçük görüyor.
items.simple: You think someone is not as good as you are.

items.example: Be careful what you say. He has a short fuse.
items.exampleTr: Ne dediğine dikkat et. Çabuk sinirlenir.
items.simple: Someone who gets angry very fast.

items.example: I really want to make a good impression on her parents.
items.exampleTr: Ailesinde iyi bir izlenim bırakmak istiyorum.
items.simple: People think nice things about you when they first meet you.

items.example: He kept a low profile after the scandal.
items.exampleTr: Skandaldan sonra göze batmamaya çalıştı.
items.simple: You stay quiet so people do not notice you.

items.en: wear your heart on your sleeve
items.example: She wears her heart on her sleeve, so you always know how she feels.
items.exampleTr: Duygularını saklamaz, nasıl hissettiğini hep bilirsin.
items.simple: Everyone can see what you feel because you show it.

items.en: He's the kind of person who… He's the kind of person who never gives up.
items.example: She's the kind of person who always helps out.
items.exampleTr: O her zaman yardım eden türden biri.
items.simple: You use this to show what someone is like.

items.en: He tends to… He tends to talk too much.
items.example: He tends to get a bit defensive when you criticise him.
items.exampleTr: Eleştirince biraz savunmaya geçme eğilimindedir.
items.simple: This is how he usually is, many times, not always.

items.en: She's not as… as she seems. She's not as shy as she seems.
items.example: He's not as confident as he seems.
items.exampleTr: Göründüğü kadar kendine güvenli değil.
items.simple: What you see outside is not what is inside.
